title: Aeternum Certified Artifact Immutability and Lineage Governance Policy
authority: Aeternum Atlas Governance & Supreme Architectural Council

core_principles.statement: Once any phase receives status VERIFIED (e.g. STATUS=VERIFIED or STATUS=PROMOTED), all generated outputs become strictly immutable historical records. They may never be edited in-place.

Any post-certification defect, inconsistency, or discrepancy discovered by subsequent forensic audits must be remediated forward by creating formal ERRATA, REVISION, or PATCH artifacts with full lineage and parent hash tracking.
Any silent modification of a certified historical file invalidates the certifying quality gate until explicitly addressed by a certified errata and hash ledger entry.

Anatomical canonical memory versions follow strict semantic lineage: minor versions (0.X.0) indicate newly promoted anatomical knowledge packs; patch versions (0.X.Y) indicate structural, infrastructure, or referential integrity normalizations with zero anatomical fact additions or alterations.
